The horizon is a required field. The operator explicitly says "Hold a slot, do not assume 60." This means the horizon is not determined yet. So we cannot accept with a specific horizon.

But the operator said "do not assume 60" and "hold a slot" - meaning they want to defer the horizon decision. 

Hmm, this is tricky. Is this a clarify or partial_accept?

The key distinction: clarify is when fields are missing/ambiguous. partial_accept is when there's a safe part plus a prohibited part. Here, the horizon is genuinely unspecified/ambiguous - the operator is explicitly saying they don't know it yet and want to hold a slot. This is more of a clarify situation because a core required parameter (horizon) is not determined.

Actually, "Hold a slot" suggests they want to reserve a study slot but haven't decided the horizon. This is a clarification request - we need the horizon before we can proceed. So clarify is appropriate.
